title: Ubukode n'imari
subtitle: Ubukode bwakiriwe, amafaranga yasohotse n'icyo buri mutungo winjiza.

summary.rentReceivedHint: Amafaranga yanditswe ko yakiriwe muri iki gihe
summary.rentDueHint: Ubukode bwagezaga igihe cyo kwishyurwa muri iki gihe
summary.outstandingHint: Ubukode bwose butarishyurwa kugeza igihe kirangiye
summary.netFormula: Ubukode bwakiriwe ukuyemo amafaranga yasohotse, muri iki gihe.

definitions.received: Ubukode bwakiriwe: ubwishyu wanditse, bufite itariki yo kwishyura iri muri iki gihe.
definitions.due: Ubukode bwagombaga kwishyurwa: ubukode bwa buri kwezi bufite itariki yo kwishyura iri muri iki gihe.
definitions.outstanding: Ibisigaye kwishyurwa: ubukode bwose bwagombaga kwishyurwa kugeza igihe kirangiye, ukuyemo ubwishyu bwose bwanditswe kugeza icyo gihe.
definitions.expenses: Amafaranga yasohotse: ayanditswe afite itariki iri muri iki gihe. Ibyatwawe n'igisanwa bibarwa rimwe gusa.
definitions.net: Amafaranga asigaye = ubukode bwakiriwe − amafaranga yasohotse.
definitions.excluded: Ntibirimo: imisoro utanditse, kwishyura inguzanyo, igabanuka ry'agaciro n'andi mafaranga yose atanditswe muri Rental_Control. Ibi ni inyandiko y'ibyo wanditse, si inyungu yemejwe.

rent.title: Ubukode bwa buri mupangayi
rent.emptyText: Ubukode bugaragara hano iyo umupangayi ufite ubukode bwa buri kwezi yinjiye muri imwe mu nzu zawe.
rent.dueDayValue: bwishyurwa ku munsi wa {{day}} wa buri kwezi
rent.recordHelp: Andika amafaranga wamaze kwakira. Rental_Control ntiyohereza cyangwa ngo yakire amafaranga.
rent.owesNow: Ibisigaye kwishyurwa ubu: {{amount}} (ubukode bwa buri kwezi {{rent}}).
rent.referenceHint: Urugero: nimero y'ihererekanya rya mobile money.
rent.noCharges: Nta bukode buragera igihe cyo kwishyurwa.
rent.deletePaymentText: Ubwishyu bwa {{amount}} bwakiriwe ku itariki {{date}} buzakurwa mu nyandiko. Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.
rent.manualNote: Ubwishyu bubanza kwishyura ukwezi kwa kera kutarishyurwa.

expenses.title: Amafaranga yasohotse
expenses.subtitle: Amafaranga yakoreshejwe ku mitungo yawe.
expenses.addHelp: Andika amafaranga yakoreshejwe ku mutungo, nka fagitire y'amazi cyangwa umushahara w'umuzamu.
expenses.unitHint: Siga ubusa niba ari ay'umutungo wose.
expenses.repairTip: Ku gisanwa gifitanye isano n'ikibazo cy'umupangayi, koresha “Andika igisanwa” kuri icyo kibazo, kugira ngo amafaranga atabarwa kabiri.
expenses.emptyText: Ongeraho amafaranga yasohotse, cyangwa wandike ibyatwawe n'igisanwa ku kibazo cyo gusana.
